# atlas-3797-cloze-phase2

Drive **Phase 2** of #3797 (reviewed cloze). Phase 0 generator and Phase 1 Tatoeba yield path already merged (#3859, #5498, #5183).

## ROUTING_CARD_V1
- tier: practical
- model_x_harness: agy / gemini-3.7-flash-high (language-lane)
- why_this_tier: Ukrainian cloze review; not architecture
- advisor_packet: n/a
- owned_paths: lexicon-practice cloze allowlist / issue #3797
- acceptance_cmd: named candidate count + first reviewed batch OR a tool-proved blocker posted on #3797

## Work
1. Read #3797 body + comments. Quote what Phase 1 actually shipped (PR SHAs). Do not re-do Phase 0/1.
2. Phase 2 is **review at scale**: Russianism/calque/CEFR/case/naturalness → attest approved into allowlisted `lexicon-practice` cloze sources.
3. Start a **bounded** first review batch (not the whole 188k). Propose size with a denominator. VESUM/`sources` every UA claim.
4. If the generator output is missing on disk, say so with paths — do not invent sentences.
5. PR only for attested approved items + tests. Do not auto-merge. Do not close #3797 until Phase 2 ACs are met.

- Phase 3 UI attribution
- Audio / #4696
- Lowering cloze quality bars

### Phase 2 Review: First Reviewed Cloze Batch (#3797)

---

### 1. Phase 0 & Phase 1 Prior Delivery Audit

From issue [#3797](https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/issues/3797) and merged PR history:
- **Phase 0 — Tatoeba→cloze generator & fixtures**: Shipped in PR [#3859](https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/pull/3859) (Merge commit [`96cbfc7532`](https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/commit/96cbfc7532b5084dfc6f8423808ea3b942df55e2)).
- **Phase 1 — Real candidate generation & yield path**: Shipped in PR [#5498](https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/pull/5498) (Merge commit [`95385b9a5e`](https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/commit/95385b9a5e1523289443205c62b63c1cfc48db58)), which generated **1,981** candidates across 217,316 UK–EN pairs and committed [`docs/atlas/tatoeba-cloze-yield-phase1-retry.json`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/atlas-3797-cloze-phase2/docs/atlas/tatoeba-cloze-yield-phase1-retry.json) and [`docs/atlas/tatoeba-cloze-sample.json`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/atlas-3797-cloze-phase2/docs/atlas/tatoeba-cloze-sample.json).
- **Curriculum Cloze Batch 1**: Shipped in PR [#5183](https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/pull/5183) (Merge commit [`d10afdfd77`](https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/commit/d10afdfd77b7951540e5968b2e3f464c8f832264)), adding 30 reviewed A1 curriculum cloze sentences (52 total).

---

### 2. Disk State & Candidate Availability

- The full candidate dump `.agent/tmp/tatoeba/candidates-phase1-retry-full.json` (1,981 items) is gitignored scratch and is **missing on disk** in fresh checkouts/worktrees.
- The canonical committed quality sample [`docs/atlas/tatoeba-cloze-sample.json`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/atlas-3797-cloze-phase2/docs/atlas/tatoeba-cloze-sample.json) (30 stratified items spanning A1–C1 across all 3 case rules) is present on disk and forms the bounded candidate pool for this first review batch.

---

### 3. Bounded First Review Batch: 30 / 1,981 Candidates

- **Batch denominator**: 1,981 candidates emitted in Phase 1 ([`docs/atlas/tatoeba-cloze-yield-phase1-retry.json`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/atlas-3797-cloze-phase2/docs/atlas/tatoeba-cloze-yield-phase1-retry.json)).
- **Reviewed batch size**: 30 candidates (100% of the committed Phase 1 sample).
- **Approval count**: **17 / 30 (56.7%) approved**, **13 / 30 (43.3%) rejected**.

#### Comprehensive Review Table

| # | Lemma | Target Form | Level | Rule | Ukrainian Frame & English | Verdict | Linguistic & VESUM Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | бібліотека | бібліотеку | A1 | `accusative_direct_object` | `Я заблукав шукаючи ___.` (*I got lost trying to find the library.*) | **REJECT** | Missing comma before adverbial participle phrase (`дієприслівниковий зворот`); дієприслівник syntax is B1+, misclassified as A1. |
| 2 | бібліотека | бібліотеку | A1 | `accusative_direct_object` | `Тобі слід подивитися на мою ___.` (*You should see my library.*) | **REJECT** | Rule mismatch: prepositional frame (`подивитися на + Acc`), not transitive direct object. |
| 3 | валіза | валізу | A1 | `accusative_direct_object` | `Ми закрили ___.` (*We closed the suitcase.*) | **APPROVE** | Natural transitive frame; VESUM unambiguous `noun:inanim:f:v_zna`; clean A1. |
| 4 | день | днях | A1 | `locative_static_na` | `Я можу на ___ заскочити до тебе?` (*Could I drop by your place one of these days?*) | **REJECT** | Russianism calque: *«на днях»* vs normative Ukrainian *«цими днями» / «днями»* (Antonenko-Davydovych, *Як ми говоримо*). |
| 5 | заняття | заняттях | A1 | `locative_static_na` | `Мене вчора не було на ___.` (*I wasn't in class yesterday.*) | **APPROVE** | Standard locative plural *«бути на заняттях»*; VESUM `noun:inanim:p:v_mis`. |
| 6 | борг | боргах | A1 | `locative_static_u` | `Він по вуха в ___.` (*He's deep in debt.*) | **REJECT** | Idiom *«по вуха в боргах»* and financial lemma *борг* are B1+ vocabulary/structures, misleveled at A1. |
| 7 | газета | газетах | A1 | `locative_static_u` | `Те, що пишуть у ___, — правда.` (*What the newspapers say is true.*) | **APPROVE** | Clear locative plural *«писати у газетах»*; VESUM `noun:inanim:p:v_mis`. |
| 8 | абетка | абетку | A2 | `accusative_direct_object` | `Пишіть ___ великими літерами.` (*Write the alphabet in capitals.*) | **APPROVE** | Standard direct object; VESUM `noun:inanim:f:v_zna`. |
| 9 | абетка | абетку | A2 | `accusative_direct_object` | `Ти розумієш фонетичну ___?` (*Can you read phonetic signs?*) | **REJECT** | EN translation mismatch (*"phonetic signs"* vs *фонетична абетка*); EN author is null marker `\N` (fails attribution contract). |
| 10 | абетка | абетку | A2 | `accusative_direct_object` | `Пан Легрос може розказати ___ у зворотньому порядку.` | **REJECT** | Orthographic error in source: *«зворотньому»* (hard stem adjective requires *«зворотному»* per Ukrainian Orthography). |
| 11 | вечірка | вечірках | A2 | `locative_static_na` | `Я зазвичай не п'ю вино на ___.` (*I don't usually drink wine at parties.*) | **APPROVE** | Authentic everyday Ukrainian; VESUM `noun:inanim:p:v_mis`. |
| 12 | комп'ютер | комп'ютерах | A2 | `locative_static_na` | `Він добре розуміється на ___.` (*He is quite at home with computers.*) | **APPROVE** | Idiomatic locative construction *«розумітися на чомусь»*; VESUM `noun:inanim:p:v_mis`. |
| 13 | зоопарк | зоопарках | A2 | `locative_static_u` | `Кондори ніколи не розмножувалися в ___.` (*Condors have never bred in zoos.*) | **REJECT** | Low-frequency obscure noun *кондори* unsuitable for A2 drill. |
| 14 | зоопарк | зоопарках | A2 | `locative_static_u` | `Я не бачу нічого поганого в ___.` (*I don't see anything wrong with zoos.*) | **APPROVE** | Clean, accessible conversational A2 locative plural frame. |
| 15 | аварія | аварію | B1 | `accusative_direct_object` | `Ніколи в житті я не бачив таку жахливу ___.` | **REJECT** | Negated transitive verb *«не бачив»* canonically governs Genitive (*такої жахливої аварії*); drilling Accusative here promotes non-normative case usage. |
| 16 | аварія | аварію | B1 | `accusative_direct_object` | `Ти не можеш винуватити його через цю ___.` | **REJECT** | Rule mismatch: prepositional causal phrase (*«через цю аварію»*), not direct object. |
| 17 | аварія | аварію | B1 | `accusative_direct_object` | `Том щось казав про свою ___?` | **REJECT** | Rule mismatch: prepositional phrase (*«про свою аварію»*), not direct object. |
| 18 | барабан | барабанах | B1 | `locative_static_na` | `Я грав на ___.` (*I played the drums.*) | **APPROVE** | Authentic musical instrument locative frame *«грати на барабанах»*; VESUM `noun:inanim:p:v_mis`. |
| 19 | барабан | барабанах | B1 | `locative_static_na` | `Том насправді грає на ___?` (*Does Tom actually play the drums?*) | **APPROVE** | Grammatically valid instrument locative frame. |
| 20 | аварія | аваріях | B1 | `locative_static_u` | `Багато хто гине в ___ на дорозі.` (*Many people die in traffic accidents.*) | **APPROVE** | Natural locative plural; VESUM `noun:inanim:p:v_mis`. |
| 21 | деталь | деталях | B1 | `locative_static_u` | `Диявол криється в ___.` (*The devil is in the details.*) | **APPROVE** | Standard winged idiom; VESUM `noun:inanim:p:v_mis`. |
| 22 | броня | броню | B2 | `accusative_direct_object` | `Я хотів би підтвердити ___ на 30 число.` (*I'd like to confirm my reservation for the 30th.*) | **REJECT** | Semantic Russianism / false friend: *броня* = armor; reservation = *бронювання* (or colloquial *бронь*). |
| 23 | гірчиця | гірчицю | B2 | `accusative_direct_object` | `Я забув купити ___.` (*I forgot to buy mustard.*) | **APPROVE** | Standard transitive accusative singular; VESUM `noun:inanim:f:v_zna`. |
| 24 | драбина | драбину | B2 | `accusative_direct_object` | `Хлопець схопив ___ і почав лізти вгору.` (*The boy seized the ladder, and began to climb.*) | **APPROVE** | Authentic Ukrainian noun *драбина*; VESUM `noun:inanim:f:v_zna`. |
| 25 | заручник | заручниках | B2 | `locative_static_u` | `Мене тримали у ___.` (*I was held hostage.*) | **APPROVE** | Fixed locative idiom *«тримати в заручниках»*; VESUM `noun:anim:p:v_mis`. |
| 26 | межа | межах | B2 | `locative_static_u` | `Будь ласка, залишайтеся в ___ досяжності.` (*Please stay within earshot.*) | **APPROVE** | Normative prepositional phrase *«в межах досяжності»*; VESUM `noun:inanim:p:v_mis`. |
| 27 | головоломка | головоломку | C1 | `accusative_direct_object` | `Цю ___ було складно розв'язати.` (*It was difficult to solve this puzzle.*) | **APPROVE** | Impersonal predicate with transitive infinitive *розв'язати*; VESUM `noun:inanim:f:v_zna`. |
| 28 | лазанья | лазанью | C1 | `accusative_direct_object` | `Я обожнюю ___.` (*I love lasagna.*) | **APPROVE** | Direct object of *обожнювати*; VESUM `noun:inanim:f:v_zna`. |
| 29 | лазанья | лазанью | C1 | `accusative_direct_object` | `Я зробив фантастичну ___.` (*I made some fantastic lasagna.*) | **APPROVE** | Clean transitive direct object frame. |
| 30 | крамниця | крамницях | C1 | `locative_static_u` | `На вихідних у ___ спокійно.` (*Shops are quiet on weekdays.*) | **REJECT** | Translation error: *«на вихідних»* means *weekends*, whereas the English translation says *«on weekdays»*. |
